t: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
d: Christophe Rocancourt is a French impostor and con artist who scammed rich and powerful people by masquerading in turn as a French nobleman, the heir to the Rockefeller family, or as a Russian prince.

t: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
d: Matthew Cox is a former mortgage broker from Florida who found himself on the Secret Service's most wanted list; he made millions falsifying homeownership and mortgage documents for five times the properties' actual worth.

t: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
d: Jan Lewan is the polka sensation from Pennsylvania who fleeced millions of investors with his classic Ponzi scheme; his name shot to fame when Netflix produced the movie "Polka King" with actor Jack Black playing Jan Lewan.

t: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
d: Nicknamed The Chameleon, Frédéric Bourdin is a former French serial imposter who claims to have faked at least five hundred false identities, including a young Texas boy who went missing in the mid-90s.

t: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
d: Shaun Greenhalgh is a British artist and art forger; between 1989 and 2006, he produced a number of forgeries including Roman and Chinese art objects, and medieval Christian relics, that fooled some of the world's most respected art institutions.

t: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
d: Dubbed the "Mini Madoff," Kiener is one of Germany's greatest con artists, tricking thousands of private investors and banks, including Barclays and J.P. Morgan, to the tune of more than $300 million.

st: Vanilla: The Bean That Shaped the Future of Food
d: In 1841 on the small island of Réunion, a 12-year-old slave did something no one had done before; the vanilla bean takes the world by storm, sparking the artificial flavor revolution and forever changing how we eat.

t: The Tracker's Diary: Tigers of Nepal
d: Casey and his camera crew arrive in Nepal and meet up with local tiger guide, Rajan Chadhary; a seasoned tracker, Rajan guides the team around Bardiya National Park's tiger habitat and establishes a lay of the land.

t: The Tracker's Diary: Tigers of Nepal
d: While walking in the jungle, Casey and the team find a tiger; the tracks lead to a lot of dead ends, but they discover a plethora of other wildlife along the way.

t: The Tracker's Diary: Tigers of Nepal
d: Casey and Rajan discuss different tactics for finding tigers: sit and wait for them to come to the water, or track them on foot through the jungle.
